title: Gas Reduction Firing Service (ongoing)
source_quote: The Canton Clay Works offers a high-fire glaze/gas reduction firing service with access to close to thirty spectacular glazes!
evidence_sentence: The gas reduction page describes a high-fire glaze/gas reduction firing service available to outside artists.
evidence_quote: The Canton Clay Works offers a high-fire glaze/gas reduction firing service with access to close to thirty spectacular glazes!
summary: Ongoing gas reduction firing service for cone 10-11 clay bodies. Drop-off by appointment; new users attend a short glazing demonstration. Work is bisque-fired if needed. Firing fee 9 cents per cubic inch; bisque firing 3.5 cents per cubic inch.
cost_text: Gas reduction: 9 cents per cubic inch; bisque firing: 3.5 cents per cubic inch
pay_text: Billed quarterly; payment via PayPal or website
how_to_join: Contact studio to arrange drop-off appointment
